models_evaluated: machine learning-based prognostic tool for colorectal liver metastases

links.outcome: Reader AUC for 3-year mortality with versus without AI tool assistance
links.effect: Model assistance significantly improved AUC for 3-year mortality prediction (mean difference 0.091; 95% CI 0.001-0.181; P = 0.048); decision time 2.53 vs 3.04 minutes.
links.quote: Model assistance significantly improved the AUC for 3-year mortality prediction (mean difference 0.091; 95% CI 0.001-0.181; P = 0.048) and consistently improved accuracy across secondary prognostic endpoints.

screen.reason: This is a prospective multi-reader multi-case (MRMC) reader study comparing clinician prognostic performance with versus without an AI risk prediction tool.
